skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — generate and add background music that matches the mood of my video — and...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Free Video Music Generator skill.
- Instantly add AI-generated background music to your video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB).
- Simple workflow: upload a video, describe the mood, and get a music-backed video in 30-60 seconds.
- No need for professional editing software or manual music licensing.
- Includes cloud-based session handling, credit tracking, and export process with error handling.
- Especially useful for TikTok creators seeking copyright-free background music.
